# hubspot-reconciliation-reviewer

Review the daily HubSpot property reconciliation drift report, cluster it by mapper field, and file one Shortcut story per new cluster.

- **Command:** `/hubspot-reconciliation-reviewer`
- **Schedule:** 09:00 mon-fri
- **Source:** datadog, mongodb, shortcut (read-write)
- **Required inputs:** `log_query`, `lookback`
- **Backend:** `claude`

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Notes |
|-------|---------|-------|
| `log_query` | `@event:hubspot.property_reconciliation.drifted_record @dd.service:temporal-worker-production` | Structured drift events emitted by logDriftedRecordsForSummary in reconcileHubSpotProperties.activity.ts. Scoped to the production worker: @hubspotEnvironment is NOT present on these events (it is only on the run summary), so @dd.service is the only environment filter available. |
| `lookback` | `30h` | One full day plus margin, so a late-running workflow is still caught. |
| `bot_marker` | `🤖` | Prefix on every Shortcut story this daemon creates, so its stories are identifiable and reply/triage daemons can tell them apart. |
| `max_new_stories` | `3` | Most new clusters to file in a single run. Drift is bursty — 830 records in one day on 2026-07-30 against single digits either side — so the cap matters even though clustering already collapses ~1000 records into a handful of stories. |
| `story_labels` | `crm-data-discrepancy` | Labels stamped on every story, comma-separated. Exact strings: the workspace holds 265 labels and near-miss spellings silently create new ones. |
| `story_type` | `bug` | Existing stories in this class use bug branches (naokimita/bug/sc-51424/...). |
| `epic_id` | `51847` | 👥 CRM - Data Discrepancy and Reconciliation. Pinned rather than inferred — an inferred epic drifts between runs and scatters the backlog.  Was 46244 (👥 CRM - Post Launch) until 2026-08-13. That epic is where this work started, but reconciliation drift outgrew it and got its own; every story this daemon had filed was hand-moved off 46244 afterwards, one at a time. The pin is the only thing that decides where a story lands, so a stale pin is not a cosmetic wrong — it is a manual move per story, forever. |
| `team` | `686d63b1-4750-4b66-b819-2da4ac86d332` | Squad 3 - BAR, which owns epic 51847. |
| `product_area` | `Hubspot CRM` | Stamps the "Hubspot CRM" Product Area on every story this daemon files. Until 2026-09-08 someone on the business side added it by hand to each new story; without it the story is missing from the views that slice the board by product surface. Exact option label from the workspace's Product Area field — a near miss does not create a new option the way a label name would, it fails the create, so the skill files the story without the field and says so. |
| `triage_state` | `Backlog` | Overrides the fleet default ("To Do" in profiles/shortcut/profile.toml). CONSEQUENCE: story-reviewer's gate matches on the fleet triage state, so stories filed here are NOT auto-triaged into work-queue. That is deliberate — deciding whether Mongo or HubSpot is authoritative for a drifted field is a human call, not something to hand to an autonomous implementer. |

## Gate

`discover.sh` decides whether the daemon fires on a given run.

See [skill/SKILL.md](skill/SKILL.md) for the full prompt.
